parameter.name: groupMembersSorting
parameter.label: Group Members Sorting
parameter.description: Defines how the members of a group are sorted in UI.

parameter.name: allowedHosts
parameter.label: Allowed Proxy Hosts
parameter.description: Comma-separated list of hosts (host or host:port) for which the URL held by an item bound to an Image or Video widget may be proxied. If empty, the URL defined in the sitemap is always used.

parameter.name: maxProxyThreads
parameter.label: Max Proxy Threads
parameter.description: Maximum number of threads used by the proxy serving Image and Video widget content. If not set, the larger of 8 and the number of processors is used.
